column1: # Question set for tail-dense.jsonl. Tab-separated: n, class, question, require, forbid, answer.
# class: gold — one question per gold row, in gold order; stale — answerable from the
# repository and contradicted by a seeded document. require: ERE patterns separated
# by ;; that an answer must all match; forbid: patterns it must not match. The
# patterns avoid every word the question uses. answer: what the oracle writes.

column3: Which deploy target do release trains use right now, and why not the other one?
column6: staging-blue — staging-green is frozen for the parser rewrite until RB-417 closes.

column3: What went wrong when `set -o pipefail` was added to `bin/deploy.sh`?
column6: The deploy hosts run busybox sh, which rejects it: "set: Illegal option -o pipefail"; it was reverted.

column3: How long does the load-balancer drain take, and which runbook records it?
column6: 150 seconds, recorded in RB-533; nobody deploys inside a drain window.

column3: What does the nightly smoke hook need that the repository does not provide, and where does its value live?
column6: SMOKE_TOKEN, which CI reads from the vault path ops/vault/releasekit-smoke (RB-590).

column3: Why does `git init --initial-branch` fail on the deploy hosts, and what is used instead?
column6: The hosts run git 2.30, which predates the option; a plain init then git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main (RB-611).

column3: When do release trains cut, and when does code freeze start?
column6: Trains cut Tuesdays at 10:00 UTC; freeze starts Friday 16:00 UTC.

column3: What is required before anyone edits `ops/runbook-417.txt`?
column6: An OPS- ticket and ops sign-off, because bin/deploy.sh parses the file.

column3: Where does `make test` run, and why not on the deploy hosts?
column6: On the build host only; under busybox the parser test fails (RB-622).

column3: What exit code does `make deploy` return when `DEPLOY_ENV` is unset?
column6: Exit 3 — bin/deploy.sh says so; the memory document claiming otherwise is stale.
